Solid Objects: Cloudflare Durable Objects for Rails
item.description: Durable, serialized TypeScript objects on SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, exercised by a deployed reference application (Shuffle Up and Play). Each identity runs one call at a time. Pre-1.0 v0.13.1, MIT, Node 24.15+. No Redis required. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: AI Shouldn't Cost More Than It Saves
item.description: We used AI ubiquitously in this project, from specs through implementation and in production. Learn how we did it. (1 source: rubyweekly)

item.title: RubyLLM::Schema is Now Schematist: A JSON Schema DSL for Ruby
item.description: Schematist is a Ruby JSON Schema DSL with full Draft 2020-12 coverage, render-time values, standards-compliant output, and no runtime dependencies. (1 source: rubyweekly)
